summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature test for owner batch: registration passkey removal, post-registration passkey prompt (headless silent + CDP virtual authenticator flow), mobile car detail redesign (header back arrow, no in-page back button, no duplicated title block, always-visible sticky bar, enquiry between photos and specs), desktop unchanged, and saved-searches + language-switcher regression. All items verified PASS.

test_results_detail.registration_screen_no_passkey: PASS - /en/login?mode=register has no passkey-login-button (nor OR divider). auth-switch-mode toggles it back. /en/login (default sign-in) has it.
test_results_detail.registration_end_to_end: PASS - POST /api/auth/register returns 200, user lands on /en with header account link visible.
test_results_detail.passkey_prompt_headless_no_authenticator: PASS - No dialog appears, page fully interactive, no stuck overlay.
test_results_detail.passkey_prompt_with_virtual_authenticato: PASS via CDP WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator (ctap2, internal, hasResidentKey, isUserVerified). Dialog appears with passkey-prompt-create and passkey-prompt-later. 'Maybe later' closes dialog with no API call and does not reappear on navigation. On a fresh registration + click Create, POST /api/auth/passkey/register/options (200) and POST /api/auth/passkey/register/verify (200) are called and the passkey is listed on /en/account.
test_results_detail.passkey_signin_untouched: PASS - /api/auth/passkey/login/options fires when clicking passkey-login-button on sign-in screen; no scary error surfaced (cancellation is silent).
test_results_detail.mobile_car_detail_bg_and_en: PASS both /bg/car/42318384 and /en/car/42318384 at 390x844 - header-back-button visible; back-to-results NOT painted; detail-title block NOT painted; detail-sticky-bar visible at scrollY 0 (opacity 1, position fixed) and still visible while scrolling; container clears the fixed bar (pt-[72px]).
test_results_detail.mobile_header_back_navigates_back: PASS - clicking header-back-button on detail page navigates back to results list.
test_results_detail.mobile_enquiry_placement: PASS - exactly one enquiry-open-button painted (top=476), positioned AFTER detail-thumb-strip (bottom=434) and BEFORE detail-specs (top=548).
test_results_detail.desktop_car_detail_unchanged: PASS at 1920x900 - back-to-results painted, header-back-button NOT painted, detail-title painted, sticky bar opacity 0 at scrollY 0 then 1 after scroll 500, exactly one enquiry button painted, dialog opens.
test_results_detail.regression_saved_searches: PASS - /en/searches shows saved search (2019+, 89,327 cars now) with thumbnail; delete/rename controls available.
test_results_detail.regression_language_switcher: PASS - RO switch changes URL to /ro?sort=newest and currency shown as RON (79,755 RON in listings).

critical_code_review_comments: PasskeyPrompt correctly uses platformPasskeyAvailable() to gate the dialog - no dialog on non-supporting environments as intended.
LoginPage: passkey block is correctly gated on `passkeySupported && !registering`.
CarDetailPage: mobile enquiry block placement (mt-4 lg:hidden right after photos) and desktop `hidden lg:block` next to specs both verified painted exclusively per breakpoint - no duplication.
test_credentials: admin@encarskin.com / AdminTest2026! used for saved-search regression. Throwaway registrations used qa+<timestamp>@example.com with password TestPass2026!.
seed_data_creation: 3 throwaway users registered (qa+<ts>@example.com). 1 admin saved-search 2019+ created (still present on /en/searches after run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CDP virtual authenticator flow works: `client = await context.new_cdp_session(page); await client.send('WebAuthn.enable'); await client.send('WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator', {options: {...}})`. Use `enquiry-open-button` (not `detail-enquiry-button`) as the enquiry testid. detail-sticky-bar is position:fixed so `offsetParent` is null - use getComputedStyle+rect for visibility checks. All owner-requested items in this batch verified.
